339-677-8227-8296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-8227-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6517-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6517-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

791-4695-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-4695-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

225-4094-4772-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

549-4017-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-4017-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1806-2060-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
When Eternal Scourge enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

104-1545-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1545-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1796-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-3263-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
1978-3263-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat

5686-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5686-6701--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2438-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2438-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

413-1052-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-1052-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

856-2267-4050-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-4050-4321.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-3174-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
2511-3174-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

428-1694-2770-3908.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
428-1694-2770-3908.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-1659-1671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-1671.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

974-1409-5470.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1409-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Ghired by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ghired enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-1409-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and/or use Deadeye Navigator to blink any other creature(s) as desired.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2921-2923.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2921-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

1477-2793-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Extruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

2084-2500.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Mirage Mirror into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1446-4549-4659-4680-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1446-4549-4659-4680-4929.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, adding {U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3194-4935.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
2034-2724-3194-4935.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta dies, triggering its second ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, allowing you to cast Wormfang Manta from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the batltefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

1624-1860-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {5}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1860-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-1860-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast all spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Storvald enters the battlefield, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become one until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1283-2608-4499.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

424-4276.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U/R}{U/R}, {3}{U/R}{U/R} of which are from the same type among lands
424-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout targeting yourself naming untap lands, hold priority.
Activate Mirror Sheen to copy Turnabout.
Let the copy resolve, choosing to untap.
Repeat.
